title: Add new release repositories to automatika_robotics release team
author: mkabtoul
body:
* Name of the release team: [automatika_robotics](https://github.com/orgs/ros2-gbp/teams/automatika_robotics)

* Release repositories to add:

  * [kompass](https://github.com/automatika-robotics/kompass)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/humble/distribution.yaml#L3882)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported
  * [automatika_embodied_agents](https://github.com/automatika-robotics/ros-agents)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/humble/distribution.yaml#L734)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported
